domain_specific_rationale: From a persistence and transactional integrity perspective, deterministic idempotency key derivation SHA256(shot_version_id + prompt_version_id + provider_id + attempt_index + parameters_hash) backed by a PostgreSQL database-level unique constraint UNIQUE(provider_id, idempotency_key) on table generation_jobs is essential. It provides: 1) Distributed Deduplication: Guarantees zero duplicate job insertions across concurrent asynchronous workers and API retry loops without requiring complex distributed locks; 2) Exact Re-execution Tracking: Incorporating attempt_index into the hash calculation ensures distinct retry attempts receive distinct idempotency keys while retaining deterministic deduplication within the same execution attempt; 3) ACID Enforcement: Relies on PostgreSQL B-tree index uniqueness to reject concurrent duplicate submissions at the storage engine level with negligible overhead.
capability_impact: Protects CAP-01 (Canonical Core State) and CAP-04 (Generation Job Lifecycle) against duplicate submissions, race conditions, and phantom job creation.
residual_risk: Parameters serialization in parameters_hash must enforce canonical JSON key sorting (RFC 8785) before hashing to prevent spurious key divergence on identical payloads. Mitigated by R01/R02 contract serializer utilities.
